note: M2.9 fixtures (spec/catalogue-report.md §6.10): one fixed candidate catalogue reached by three retrieval paths and orders gives a byte-identical catalogue and body; a different candidate set changes the catalogue digest, the candidate count and the pairs. selectedIdsSha256 is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 array of the selected candidate ids sorted by bytes.

retrievals.description: Exhaustive: every corpus document, in corpus order.
A toy index returns all four documents, in reverse order.
A second toy index returns all four documents in another order.
An index selects only two documents: a different candidate set, so the candidate catalogue digest, candidateArtifactCount and pairs change.
